question: The AGMARK is the certification mark for ______ in India.
solution: The correct answer is __**agriculture products**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **AGMARK** is a certification mark used in India to ensure the quality and standardization of **agricultural products**. • It is governed under the **Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act of 1937**, which was amended in **1986** to include more agricultural commodities. • This certification is provided by the **Directorate of Marketing and Inspection (DMI)**, under the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**, Government of India. • The AGMARK certification ensures that the agricultural products meet the specified **standards of quality, purity, and hygiene**. • Products like **fruits, vegetables, cereals, pulses, spices, honey, and edible oils** are commonly certified under AGMARK. • The certification helps to boost consumer confidence and ensures that agricultural commodities sold in the market are of the desired quality.
